title: Bhagwat warns protests may serve political interests, fuel social divisions
description:
RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat on Tuesday cautioned that regime-change agitations do not resolve fundamental problems, warning that protests could become instruments of political interests and fuel divisions in society rather than delivering solutions.
Addressing the annual Vijayadashami gathering here, Bhagwat cited recent upheavals in Bangladesh, Nepal, France, and Albania, asserting that forces pursuing their own interests use regime change as a means to alter political circumstances, rarely achieving intended results.
"They claim that changing a regime will change the situation, but that has never really happened," he said.
Bhagwat claimed that a stronger India would constrain such forces, making the country a target of attempts to weaken and divide it.
While some global powers want India to develop, they do not want it to become too powerful, as it could challenge their dominance, he added.
Bhagwat performed shastra puja (weapon worship) at RSS' Vijayadashami Utsav in Nagpur.
